programme.desc: 'S2/E92'. Yaman, overwhelmed with guilt, visits Fikret's house, where he waits outside hoping Seher will let him in. Meanwhile, Ali and Duygu find the ruins where Semra was held.

programme.title: Yosef
programme.desc: 'S2/E93'. Yaman, a ruthless businessman, raises his nephew Yusuf after his brother's death. When Seher, Yusuf's caring aunt, enters their lives, love and conflict collide.

programme.title: Ouma Sarie
programme.desc: 'S5/E12 of 13'. We follow the life of Ouma Sarie. Even though her circumstances never change, she always has something new to focus her energy and exuberant spirit on.

programme.title: Tuis Met Thys
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Vanes-Mari du Toit | CityROCK Gym'. Netball icon and media personality Vanes-Mari du Toit joins Thys to discuss current affairs, sport and financial news, while Lisa challenges herself on the climbing walls at CityROCK Gym.

programme.title: Just For Laughs Gags
programme.desc: 'S18/E8'. There's no sound, but there sure are plenty of laughs. This crazy Quebec-based troupe uses the city as its stage, and its inhabitants, or victims, as characters.

programme.title: Minute To Win It
programme.desc: 'S1/E138'. Guy Fieri leads competitors through a series of simple games that can reward them a one million dollar prize. Each contestant uses household items to complete a game in 60 seconds.

programme.title: Live Lotto Draw
programme.desc: 'S8/E38'. Catch all the excitement as South Africa's next lottery jackpot winner is revealed Live. Tune in for the chance to see if you are the lucky winner.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E30'. Kurt finds himself in a predicament. Mesut wants Daghan to pull himself together. Gurkan is still on Daghan's case.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E31'. Jasmin decides to take matters into her own hands. Gurkan follows Daghan and finds a witness. Ekber has a trick up his sleeve.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E32'. Daghan walks free, while the Zakkum Brothers return and unleash chaos. Kurt's life hangs in Ekber's hands. Meester secures the laptop-until Cerrah shows up, armed and ready.

programme.title: Vlymskerp
programme.desc: 'S1/E33'. Daghan tries to help an old teacher. Enver is fighting the Zakkum brothers, and Mesut has a big scare.
